newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Outlaws kill over 500 Bangladeshis in one year.
newsitem.headline: Outlaws kill over 500 Bangladeshis in one year.

text.p: Outlawed groups that say they are fighting for the rights of the under-privileged in Bangladesh killed more than 500 people in southwestern districts last year, police said on Wednesday.
Most victims died in fights between rival groups, police said. Others were killed by their own group members for spying for police or helping rivals.
Some people were gunned down because they refused to give shelter or money to the outlaws, a police officer in Jessore said.
Police said the biggest outlaw group is the Sharbahara Party (the party of have-nots), followed by the Purba Banglar Communist Party and the Biplobi Communist Party.
The outlaws have said they want to establish the rights of the down-trodden and poor through armed struggle, but police said their activities were confined mainly to robbery, killing and abduction.
The outlaws have also raided police camps and seized firearms, police said.
